answers.studentAnswerText: Used double angle identity: sin(x)cos(x) = (1/2)sin(2x). Antiderivative is -(1/4)cos(2x). Evaluated between 0 and pi/2 gives -1/4(-1 - 1) = 1/2.
Constructed rectangle with sides b and h. Triangle is half the rectangle. Area = 0.5 * b * h.
